response.sql: WITH member_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM member_counts), member_shares AS (SELECT link_to_major, member_count, CAST(member_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share FROM member_counts), avg_share_value AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM member_shares), above_avg_groups AS (SELECT member_count, share FROM member_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value)) SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value)) as average_above_average FROM above_avg_groups
